name: Barbed Wire
desc: REBUILT — your note: too blobby, not fine. Now concertina razor coils: dense fine loops + barb ticks, CC breathes in the coil halos, barb tips pin near-max.

name: Basalt
desc: NEW (replaces Tread Plate) — columnar basalt end-on: hot/cold column clans, chipped sparkling rims, onion-fracture rings giving every column its own radial flash signature.

name: Croc Hide
desc: NEW (replaces Scale Armor) — rounded-rect osteoderm scutes (SDF grid) with keeled domes, mirror caps on crests, wet CC rivers in the wrinkle channels; scattered blue scutes.

name: Diamondback
desc: NEW (replaces Serpentine) — rattler diamond chain on a winding spine; the chain IGNITES progressively along its length (traveling gradient phase per row), pale keel borders.

name: Dragonfly
desc: NEW (replaces Shatter Web) — two-tier wing venation (primary veins + secondary mesh); only the BIG membrane panes ignite blue (size-graded thin film), veins run near-max conduits.

name: Ebru Marble
desc: NEW (replaces Sonar) — Turkish paper-marbling: ink streams combed into feathered chevrons; three inks = three spec identities (tinted metal / dielectric blue / textured gold).

name: Feather Fall
desc: REBUILT — your note: blobby / no depth / muddy. Now crisp micro plumes with true DROP SHADOWS (offset ghost layer goes dead-matte in spec — the depth reads in the shift too).

name: Gila Bead
desc: NEW (replaces Pin Matrix) — gila-monster beaded reticulation in two clans (metal crowns vs mirror domes) with a live crawling border wire between them.

name: Herringbone
desc: REBUILT — your note: shift not coming through. Now COMET PLANKS: every plank fades metal->clearcoat along its own length, rows alternate direction, grout dead-dark.

name: Honeycomb
desc: REBUILT — your note: spec weak + disliked design. Now per-cell HONEY FILL levels with meniscus highlights, golden metal walls, dead wax-capped cells as contrast beats.

name: Inferno Veins
desc: REBUILT — your note: not shifting even crushed. Metal floor now NEVER collapses (physics-gated); veins are thin CC infernos with graded halos + plate striation shimmer.

name: Labyrinth
desc: REBUILT — your note: pattern AND spec won't shift. Now square-spiral maze tiles (alternating chirality); corridors flood CC by depth-into-the-spiral, centers detonate.

name: Mudcrack
desc: NEW (replaces Voronoi Silk) — dried lakebed: crack canyons run deep CC, CURLED LIPS ridge metal (double distance-band), plate cores crossfade on a slow macro gradient.

name: Nanoweave
desc: REBUILT — your note: weak all around. Now micro twill with LIVE DATA FIBERS (~26%) carrying CC current — dashes race along threads with white-hot pulse heads.

name: Octo Suckers
desc: NEW (replaces Origami) — curling tapered arms of suckers; every cup a wet CC pool deepening toward its pore, every lip a metal ring, papillae shimmer between.

name: Penrose
desc: NEW (replaces Wiremesh) — de Bruijn five-grid quasicrystal: NEVER repeats anywhere on the car; gold star suns, cyan anti-star wells, aperiodic CC flood across the low field.

name: Python Skin
desc: NEW (replaces Orbit Swarm) — python rosette saddles grown as blotch colonies with pale gold rims; saddle hearts pool deep CC, keeled belly scales micro-shimmer underneath.

name: Rivet Array
desc: REBUILT — your note: spec makes no sense / repeated. Now aircraft skin: per-panel brushed grain directions, rivet lines only along seams, scattered cool-mirror panels, lap-joint shadows.

name: Stingray
desc: NEW (replaces Perforated) — shagreen pearl-bead leather (size-jittered hex packing) with a thin WINDING eye-stone ridge; eye-line beads flip to pure-blue dielectric mirror.

name: Tiger Slash
desc: REBUILT — your note: not coming through. Now organic forked tapered stripes in two clans — blue-mirror slashes vs molten-metal slashes — swept by a cross-stripe gradient.

name: Topo Lines
desc: REBUILT — your note: pattern in spec ALL WRONG. Now bathymetric: the elevation FIELD drives CC (striped by alternating contour intervals), peaks detonate, bounded blue basins.

name: Tortoise
desc: NEW (replaces Thorn Bramble) — shell plates with INTERIOR GROWTH RINGS (distance-transform sine per plate); rings flash sequentially rim-to-center, each plate on its own phase.
